There are always many people at the bus stop. Anna wrote about the day in the diary. The weather was cloudy that day. Best of all, the restroom on the second floor is being cleaned.
Anna is going to travel to London in October. Anna's favorite animal is the rabbit. Anna learned a lot about math. Stay in the right lane while driving.
Last Monday, Anna and Leo went to the ticket office. Life is full of small surprises. The ticket office is one of the best places in the city. The layover in Oslo lasts six hours.
Anna borrowed a book about math from the park. Anna hopes to visit London one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the ticket office by bike.
